name: Fresh Bell Peppers (Tatashe / Bell Trio)
description: Crisp, thick-walled, vibrant yellow, green and red bell peppers. Hand-sorted at peak sweetness directly from greenhouse harvest.
storageTip: Store unwashed in vegetable crisper tray for up to 14 days.

name: Crisp Green Bell Peppers
description: Firm, glossy green bell peppers with aromatic crunch. Perfect for jollof rice, stews, sauces, and commercial salad prep.
storageTip: Keep refrigerated in perforated bag for crispness.

name: Habanero Pepper (Ata Rodo / Scotch Bonnet)
description: Fiery, intensely aromatic fresh Scotch Bonnet habanero peppers. Hand-picked at peak pungency with rich flavor essential for soups and stews.
storageTip: Keep dry in a cool basket or freeze whole in an airtight container.

name: Farm Fresh Plum Tomatoes
description: Firm, oval plum tomatoes with deep red meat and low seed count. Gives soups, stews, and jollof rice rich consistency and natural color.
storageTip: Store at cool room temperature away from direct sun.

name: Crisp Greenhouse Cucumbers
description: Tender, thin-skinned cucumbers. Exceptionally crunchy, hydrating, and free of bitter residue.
storageTip: Wrap individually in paper towel and chill for up to 10 days.

name: Tender Green Farm Okra
description: Slender, young, crisp green pods harvested before fibrousness develops. Provides wonderful natural draw and delicate flavor for soups.
storageTip: Keep dry in refrigerator; use within 5-7 days.

name: Fresh Ugu Leaves (Fluted Pumpkin)
description: Deep green, nutrient-packed Telfairia occidentalis leaves. Freshly cut on the morning of order, rich in iron, minerals, and vibrant freshness.
storageTip: Pluck leaves, air-dry moisture, wrap in paper and chill.

name: Benue White Yam Tubers
description: Heavy, mature white yam with dry, fluffy, starchy flesh. Yields exceptionally smooth pounded yam, boiled yam, or golden yam fries.
storageTip: Store in a cool, well-ventilated pantry off concrete floors.

name: Golden Sweet Corn on the Cob
description: Plump, juicy, golden sweet corn ears picked at milk stage. Sweet, succulent kernels that burst with natural sweetness when boiled or roasted.
storageTip: Keep husks on until cooking to retain natural sweetness.

name: Fresh Organic Soursop (Graviola)
description: Exotic tropical soursop renowned for its sweet-tangy white creamy pulp and revered wellness properties. Hand-harvested tree-ripened fruit.
storageTip: Allow firm fruit to soften at room temperature, then refrigerate.

name: Rich Buttery Avocados
description: Rich, nutty, velvet-smooth avocados grown without synthetic chemicals. High in beneficial plant fats, creamy and delicious for eating or salads.
storageTip: Ripen on counter, then transfer to fridge once gently yielding.
